GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2021-12-15T18:08:29Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Clickhouse Materialized Views select column with different date
Description: Hi guys,

i have an issue when select MV column with different date period, example:

source table
```
create table if not exists source(
      `original_timestamp` DateTime64(3) DEFAULT parseDateTimeBestEffort('0001-1-1 23:00:00') CODEC(DoubleDelta, LZ4),
      `event` LowCardinality(String) DEFAULT '',
      `identity` String DEFAULT ''
    ) 
    ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree()
    partition by toWeek(identity,original_timestamp)
        order by (id)
        SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192
```
target table
```
create table if not exists target(
     day DateTime,
     identity String,
     login AggregateFunction(countIf, String, UInt8),
     register AggregateFunction(countIf, String, UInt8)
    ) 
    ENGINE = AggregatingMergeTree()
    partition by toWeek(day)
        order by (day,identity)
        SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192
```
mv table
```
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW if not exists target_mv 
    to target as
    select
    toStartOfDay(original_timestamp) as day,
    identity,
    countIf(event, event='login') as login,
    countIf(event, event='register') as register
    from source
    group by identity, day
```

query:
select
countIfMerge(login) as totalLoginEvent, //login event in the last 3 days
countIfMerge(register) as totalRegisterEvent //register event in the last 7 days
from target
group by identity,day

example expected result: totalLoginEvent is 10 (in the last 3 days) and totalRegisterEvent is 40 event in the last 7 days

please help, thanks.
